defect_assertion: filterAllowedEvents calls blockedIps.includes(event.sourceIp) inside the Array.filter callback, where blockedIps is a plain array, making each membership check O(len(blockedIps)) and the whole function O(len(events) times len(blockedIps)) -- quadratic time; converting blockedIps to a Set once up front (and calling .has() instead of .includes()) would make each check O(1) and the whole function linear.
